en: The image is a vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a grand baroque architectural ensemble with manicured gardens. Dominating the left side is a large church with twin spires, labeled as the Evangelische Hofkirche (Sophienkirche). To the center and right is an ornate palace structure with elaborate decorations, domes, and statues, identified as the Königlicher Zwinger (Royal Zwinger) with its gardens. The image captures a formal and historical urban landscape with people strolling in the gardens.
